new_written_arguments: Actual C(s)-span of original Cauchy FUNCTIONS is the quotient of full complement connection by Ann(the entire physical Haar orbit), hence dual to that orbit. The literal rational unit survives here, before quotient by polynomials.

A GLOBAL invariant ambient lift INSIDE the actual orbit defines a well-defined rational retraction of actual Cauchy functions. PP0 after the exact Borel conversion splits the polynomial-time unit; indecomposability forces full all-original-marker safety under eventual purity. Conversely safety makes the actual orbit one-dimensional trivial.

Thus eventual-pure safety is equivalent to splitting of the literal rational unit in the actual Cauchy connection, and global semisimplicity of actual or full complement monodromy is sufficient. This does not confuse global representation semisimplicity with local matrices.

Finite-cover induction of primitive complement systems surjects onto the full composite complement; its kernel is ambient L tensor the trace-zero permutation local system. Every primitive branch injects after restriction. Finite-index induction/restriction semisimplicity proves B_f globally semisimple IFF B_H(f) globally semisimple, for EVERY H before purity.

Every original graded weight piece4,5,6 is globally semisimple by Deligne. Therefore the full monodromy algebra radical J strictly lowers that three-step filtration, J3=0, and kills compact-middle W4. Eventual-pure failure iff the actual rational unit lies in JM.

If generic fibre H2 is PURE weight2, of ANY rank, full complement B is pure weight4 and globally semisimple. ALL eventually pure H(f), in EVERY H degree, are therefore safe. No tameness, local semisimplicity, acyclicity or primitive-purity reflection is needed.
essential_boundaries: Both COMPLETE exceptional MZ cases remain OPEN. Neither global unit splitting nor generic H2 purity is proved for all actual phases.

A fixed ambient lift in full homology OUTSIDE the actual orbit, or separate local fixed lifts, is insufficient. The restricted actual quotient need not inherit a limit MHS, so local full-source Tate constraints are not silently transferred.
Use actual Cauchy FUNCTION connection BEFORE quotient by C[s]; ordinary generic GM and exponential localization still lose the needed point extension.

The radical is global Jacobson radical of a finite-dimensional monodromy algebra, not a coefficient purity ideal or the span of local unipotent logarithms. Boundary ranks alone do not certify failure.

Full source semisimplicity sufficient, not necessary; actual period map may kill nonsplit components. No general monodromy/orbit producer, all-ring topological promotion, universal machine proof, new search or review gate.
